lyrics.text: Ceiling fan is turning like it's got somewhere to be
Radio is humming, it's the only one with me
Voicemail blinking red, I don't press play
If I don't hear it then it stays away
Static, static, all I hear is static
Nothing coming through and nothing coming back
Static, static, turning up the dial
I haven't really slept in a while
June says that she misses me, I think, I don't know
Her voice is in the radio, buried way down low
Every station's playing someone else's life
I just lie here waiting for the night
Static, static, all I hear is static
Nothing coming through and nothing coming back
Static, static, turning up the dial
I haven't really slept in a while
Is anybody out there
Is anybody out there
Is anybody out there
Anybody
Static, static, all I hear is static
Nothing coming through and nothing coming back
Static, static, turning up the dial
